pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pSeparates configured stone, wood and other basic materials into useful products. One input can produce multiple outputs.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Choose a live Stone Separator recipe.$p2. Supply its exact ingredient and full batch energy.$p3. Reserve space for every output, including secondary products such as sticks or shards.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pAn empty secondary output destination can matter as much as the primary one; check all pending results.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pProcessing / value recipes: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
